notes.title: 50th Anniversary Special Update!!!!
notes.content:
[h1][b]Another FPS Game is a cult piece inspired by countless movies, books, music albums and ice cream. We played this game 50 years ago with the hope that happiness will replace the grudge and anger in the world. If the game world has come to this point, there is no doubt that this game's place is undeniable.[/b][/h1]





Along with the incoming update:

[olist]
[*] - We reduce micro payments by 2.4% !!
[*]  Sounds incredible, doesn't it? We are not like other money-making companies.
[*] 
[*] - We drop the graphics so that our game works on every computer! Yes, now you can play our game on birth control devices.
[*] 
[*] - We are reducing the price of the game from $ 1,999 to $ 3. If you can't buy it at this price, you won't find it again!
[*] 
[*] - Artificial Intelligence, so the enemies in the game are very intelligent, so we made them a little stupid. No one will have trouble with the enemies by playing superhero movies and foreign music!
[*] 
[*] - We decided to narrow the playing field as we could not find our lost players in large terrains and planets.
[*] 
[*] - We made a 50% discount for DLCs sold on the black market.
[*] 
[*] - And we are celebrating our 60th anniversary with many more innovations.
[/olist]

notes.title: Most Unnecessary Update Ever!
notes.content:
[b]We've added tons of features to the game that you won't need completely. We totally think about you, the players. We increased the bug count in the game by 50% more !!![/b]

[b]     After millions of dollars of budget and decades of development, the ultimate game is completely perfect, free from mistakes, serious and confident, with you.
      This game, which has been banned due to its greatness in about 15 countries, has become an unforgettable work by the players.
      We would like to thank all the group of players who have been with us since 1864.
      As his famous philosopher said, "Oh my god this is a legendary game!".[/b]

This game will make you a maid!
